text: Adding structure to a design against a change nobody has asked for, at the cost of an extra type to name, construct and read past, is called ___ generality.
explanation: It is the counterweight to every principle in the chapter. The flashcard design's weak point — a timing parameter would touch four files — could have been avoided by wrapping the arguments in a `ReviewEvent` record, and probably should not have been, because the specification said nothing about timing. You cannot make every change cheap; you choose which to make cheap based on which you actually expect.
